description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
When Carrion Feeder dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

uses.name: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight
